description: This file defines an internal interface 'IActivationRebalancerWorker' for the Orleans server framework, specifically related to placement rebalancing. It includes method signatures for getting reports, resuming, and suspending rebalancing operations.

methods.name: GetReport
methods.description: Returns the most recent rebalancing report; also acts as a wake-up call for the rebalancer.

methods.name: ResumeRebalancing
methods.description: Resumes rebalancing if it was suspended.

methods.name: SuspendRebalancing
methods.description: Suspends rebalancing for an optional duration; null means indefinite suspension.
